description: Ready-to-use content seeded into every new company on first login.

project.description: One sample project (TEST-001) so the portal is never empty.

fleet.description: One sample vehicle so the fleet module is not empty.

form_templates.description: 8 ready-to-use form templates: prestart, toolbox talk, incident report, site inspection, sign-on register, photo record, variation request, completion sign-off.

swms_library.description: 3 SWMS templates: general site safety, working at heights, excavation and trenching.

safety_plan.description: One site safety management plan template.

cost_guide.description: 27 cost guide line items covering labour, carpentry, painting, materials, plant, and site setup.

notes: The app reads from src/server/seed/starter-packs/default/ at runtime.
content/starter-packs/default/ is the human-editable master copy.
After editing generated-json files here, copy them to the appFile path.
DOCX files in source-docx/ are the original master documents — edit these first, then regenerate JSON.
